_note: Initial guesses, tuned per place by the morning tap and the owner's weights. Values are fractional effects (0.3 = +30%).

holiday._note: Public holiday effect depends on area type, picked at onboarding.

long_weekend._note: Assumed, not measured. A run of three or more days off (weekend plus a public holiday) or a bridge day between a holiday and a weekend. Office areas empty out as people travel; residential areas get more local outings. Cloud kitchens are left alone.

_match_tv_note: Recalibrated 7 Oct 2026: Swiggy reported IPL 2026 dineout bookings +41% and delivery orders +32% year on year (platform PR, so indicative). Cafes stay slightly negative, restaurants positive.

multiplier_cap._note: Per-hour cap on the product of all signals, so stacked signals cannot produce absurd forecasts.

payday._note: Salaried India is paid around the 1st to 7th. No solid dining-specific study found; these are small starting guesses that taps and owner weights tune. Office areas respond more than residential. Weekends in the first 10 days are boosted.

aqi._note: Delhi study (Blue Sky Analytics and Near, Oct 2019 to Mar 2020): footfall in Karol Bagh, Lodhi Gardens and Connaught Place fell up to 33% as PM2.5 rose; Connaught Place went from about 17,000 to 14,000 a day at PM2.5 336. Categories follow India's CPCB PM2.5 breakpoints. Daytime (8 am to 10 pm) mean PM2.5 in ug/m3.

hotels._note: Assumed, not measured. Hotel prices for tomorrow night against the same weekday two weeks later, matched hotel by hotel (Google Hotels via SerpApi). A jump means visitors are arriving (a concert, conference, wedding season) before any listing says so. Full effect at a 50% rise; nothing below 15%.

heat._note: Assumed. Hours whose feels-like temperature (heat index) reaches 40 C keep people off the street; delivery gains. From the SerpApi weather answer box (temperature and humidity) or Open-Meteo's apparent temperature.

competitor._note: Assumed. Each nearby place of the same type that is shut tomorrow (by its Google hours, or temporarily closed) sends some of its crowd to you. Linear falloff to zero at 1 km, summed, capped.

trend._note: Assumed. Review velocity from our own snapshots of the review count: reviews per day over the last 14 days against the 42 days before. A place being discovered gets more walk-ins. Needs about 4 weeks of readings before it fires.

exams._note: Assumed, approximate. Board-exam season: families with school children stay in on evenings in residential areas; delivery picks up a little. The 2027 CBSE date sheet was not out on 9 Oct 2026; the window follows the usual mid-February to March pattern and must be replaced with the published dates.

archetypes_note_new_kinds: hotels, heat, competitor, trend and exams set their effect per signal (effectOverride); see their sections.

own_event._note: The owner's own estimate for their plans. Morning taps tune how far to trust it (weight own_event).

correction._note: Usual-curve correction from Google live readings: live / usual in hours with no notable pin, averaged in log space per part of the day, shrunk towards no change (n / (n + 6)), then per weekday towards that (n / (n + 4)). Clamped.

rain_intensity._note: Rain amounts come from Open-Meteo (free, no key; a weather model at roughly 1-10 km), Google's answer box gives only the chance of rain. Peak mm in an hour sets the size of the rain pin. Light < 1 mm, moderate 1-4 mm, heavy 4 mm and up (IMD calls 2.5 mm/h moderate and 7.5+ heavy over a day; these are per hour and assumed). Without amounts the pin keeps size 1.

after_rain._note: Assumed. When real rain (1 mm/h or more) stops between 10 am and 9 pm, people who waited it out come out for about 2 hours; delivery falls back.
